title: radarr values
description: Configurable Helm values for the radarr chart.

replicaCount.description: Number of application pod replicas to run. Increase for horizontally scalable services when storage and application behavior allow multiple pods.

image.description: Container image settings for the main application container.

repository.description: Container image repository used for the main application container.

tag.description: Container image tag to deploy. Pin this to a concrete version for repeatable installs and predictable upgrades.

pullPolicy.description: Kubernetes image pull policy for the container.

imagePullSecrets.description: Optional list of image pull secrets used when the container image is stored in a private registry.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name portion used when generating Kubernetes resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full generated Kubernetes resource name.

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations applied to application pods.

podLabels.description: Additional labels applied to application pods.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context applied to all containers in the pod.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the main application container.

env.description: Non-secret environment variables passed to the application container.

PUID.description: Linux user ID used by LinuxServer.io containers for file ownership.

PGID.description: Linux group ID used by LinuxServer.io containers for file ownership.

TZ.description: Timezone used by the application container.

UMASK.description: Mask applied to newly created files Upstream default when unset: 022.

RADARR__APP__INSTANCENAME.description: App identity and UI: InstanceName Upstream default when unset: Radarr.

RADARR__APP__THEME.description: App identity and UI: Theme Upstream default when unset: auto.

RADARR__APP__LAUNCHBROWSER.description: App identity and UI: LaunchBrowser Upstream default when unset: true.

RADARR__AUTH__APIKEY.description: Authentication: ApiKey Upstream default when unset: generated/persisted.

RADARR__AUTH__ENABLED.description: Authentication: Enabled Upstream default when unset: false.

RADARR__AUTH__METHOD.description: Authentication: Method Upstream default when unset: None (first-run setup required).

RADARR__AUTH__REQUIRED.description: Authentication: Required Upstream default when unset: Enabled.

RADARR__AUTH__TRUSTCGNATIPADDRESSES.description: Authentication: TrustCgnatIpAddresses Upstream default when unset: false.

RADARR__LOG__LEVEL.description: Logging: Level Upstream default when unset: debug.

RADARR__LOG__FILTERSENTRYEVENTS.description: Logging: FilterSentryEvents Upstream default when unset: true.

RADARR__LOG__ROTATE.description: Logging: Rotate Upstream default when unset: 50.

RADARR__LOG__SIZELIMIT.description: Logging: SizeLimit Upstream default when unset: 1.

RADARR__LOG__SQL.description: Logging: Sql Upstream default when unset: false.

RADARR__LOG__CONSOLELEVEL.description: Logging: ConsoleLevel Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__LOG__CONSOLEFORMAT.description: Logging: ConsoleFormat Upstream default when unset: Standard.

RADARR__LOG__ANALYTICSENABLED.description: Logging: AnalyticsEnabled Upstream default when unset: true.

RADARR__LOG__SYSLOGSERVER.description: Logging: SyslogServer Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__LOG__SYSLOGPORT.description: Logging: SyslogPort Upstream default when unset: 514.

RADARR__LOG__SYSLOGLEVEL.description: Logging: SyslogLevel Upstream default when unset: inherits Log.Level.

RADARR__LOG__DBENABLED.description: Logging: DbEnabled Upstream default when unset: true.

RADARR__POSTGRES__HOST.description: External PostgreSQL: Host Upstream default when unset: empty (SQLite).

RADARR__POSTGRES__PORT.description: External PostgreSQL: Port Upstream default when unset: 5432.

RADARR__POSTGRES__USER.description: External PostgreSQL: User Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__POSTGRES__PASSWORD.description: External PostgreSQL: Password Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__POSTGRES__MAINDB.description: External PostgreSQL: MainDb Upstream default when unset: radarr-main.

RADARR__POSTGRES__LOGDB.description: External PostgreSQL: LogDb Upstream default when unset: radarr-log.

RADARR__POSTGRES__MAINDBCONNECTIONSTRING.description: External PostgreSQL: MainDbConnectionString Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__POSTGRES__LOGDBCONNECTIONSTRING.description: External PostgreSQL: LogDbConnectionString Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__SERVER__URLBASE.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: UrlBase Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__SERVER__BINDADDRESS.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: BindAddress Upstream default when unset: *.

RADARR__SERVER__ALLOWEDHOSTS.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: AllowedHosts Upstream default when unset: empty (any host).

RADARR__SERVER__PORT.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: Port Upstream default when unset: 7878.

RADARR__SERVER__ENABLESSL.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: EnableSsl Upstream default when unset: false.

RADARR__SERVER__SSLPORT.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: SslPort Upstream default when unset: 9898.

RADARR__SERVER__SSLCERTPATH.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: SslCertPath Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__SERVER__SSLCERTPASSWORD.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: SslCertPassword Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__SERVER__TRUSTEDNETWORKS.description: Listener/proxy/TLS: TrustedNetworks Upstream default when unset: empty (loopback only).

RADARR__UPDATE__MECHANISM.description: Binary updater (keep image-managed): Mechanism Upstream default when unset: BuiltIn.

RADARR__UPDATE__AUTOMATICALLY.description: Binary updater (keep image-managed): Automatically Upstream default when unset: false on Linux.

RADARR__UPDATE__SCRIPTPATH.description: Binary updater (keep image-managed): ScriptPath Upstream default when unset: empty.

RADARR__UPDATE__BRANCH.description: Binary updater (keep image-managed): Branch Upstream default when unset: master.

DOCKER_MODS.description: Optional trusted LinuxServer image mods; code-executing container extension, not an application setting. Unset by default.

service.description: Kubernetes Service configuration for exposing the application inside the cluster.

type.description: Kubernetes Service type, such as ClusterIP, NodePort, or LoadBalancer.

port.description: Service port exposed inside the cluster.

targetPort.description: Container port or named port that receives traffic from the Service.

portName.description: Name assigned to the Service port and matching container port where applicable.

extraPorts.description: Additional Service ports to expose beside the primary application port.

extraContainerPorts.description: Additional container ports to add to the main application container.

persistence.description: Persistent storage configuration used by the chart.

config.description: Persistent volume settings for application configuration and state.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this feature or generated resource.

mountPath.description: Container filesystem path where this volume is mounted.

existingClaim.description: Existing PersistentVolumeClaim name to reuse instead of creating a new PVC.

storageClassName.description: StorageClass name. Leave empty to use the cluster default.

media.description: Optional media library volume mounts shared with related applications.

enabled.description: Whether to mount an existing media PersistentVolumeClaim.

mountPath.description: Path inside the container where the media volume is mounted.

readOnly.description: Mount the media volume read-only when the application only needs to inspect files.

mounts.description: Additional media mounts for multiple libraries or custom paths.

hostDevices.description: Optional host device mounts for workloads that need direct hardware access.

enabled.description: Whether to add host device mounts to the pod.

devices.description: List of host devices to expose to the container.

extraVolumes.description: Additional Kubernetes volumes appended to the pod spec.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts appended to the main application container.

ingress.description: Kubernetes Ingress configuration for exposing the application through an ingress controller.

enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource.

className.description: IngressClass name used by the target ingress controller.

annotations.description: Additional annotations applied to the Ingress resource.

hosts.description: Ingress host and path rules routed to the chart Service.

tls.description: TLS configuration for Ingress hosts and referenced certificate secrets.

httpRoute.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute configuration for exposing the application through a Gateway.

enabled.description: Whether to create a Gateway API HTTPRoute resource.

annotations.description: Additional annotations applied to the HTTPRoute resource.

parentRefs.description: Gateway parentRefs that attach this HTTPRoute to one or more Gateways.

rules.description: HTTPRoute routing rules, including path matches and filters.

items.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute rule with matches, filters, and backend references.

matches.description: HTTP match conditions for a route rule.

items.description: HTTP match condition used by an HTTPRoute rule.

type.description: Type value used by this Kubernetes or application setting.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits for the main application container.

livenessProbe.description: Kubernetes liveness probe used to restart the container when it becomes unhealthy.

port.description: Port number or named port used by this setting.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the probe first runs.

periodSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, Kubernetes runs the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe attempt times out.

failureThreshold.description: Number of failed probe attempts before Kubernetes marks the container unhealthy or unready.

readinessProbe.description: Kubernetes readiness probe used to decide when the pod can receive traffic.

port.description: Port number or named port used by this setting.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after container start before the probe first runs.

periodSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, Kubernetes runs the probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe attempt times out.

failureThreshold.description: Number of failed probe attempts before Kubernetes marks the container unhealthy or unready.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector constraints for scheduling pods onto matching nodes.

tolerations.description: Pod tolerations that allow scheduling onto tainted nodes.

affinity.description: Pod affinity and anti-affinity rules for advanced scheduling control.

envFrom.description: Existing Secret/ConfigMap environment sources; explicit env entries take precedence.

httpRoutes.description: Additional named HTTPRoutes. Each entry targets the app Service and has independent Gateway references and hostnames.

parentRefs.description: Gateway and optional listener attachments for this route.

hostnames.description: Explicit hostnames served by this route.

rules.description: Gateway API rules and filters; backendRefs are supplied by the chart. Defaults to PathPrefix /.
